messages:
kyle_cs: Heads-up — AsterBank dropped ~75% of calls and flagged a sharp rise in "wrong-label" responses after our 2025-04-10 model swap. They called it out in ticket AB-1102 and procurement is asking for a fix timeline. :grimacing:
adira_csm: Saw AB-1102. Their new Head of Data (Monica) started last week and said they're running a competitor PoC this sprint. They've stopped running critical scoring jobs. We need a quick remediation + a comms plan.
ryan_solutions: I'm on it. Offered a quick triage session and to run a targeted eval set to reproduce. They asked for a short RCA and a rollback path they can present to procurement.
leela_eng: From traces and evals: after model v2.3 rollout we see a spike in classification flips for the high-sensitivity cohort. Preliminary diff shows precision down ~18% on thresholded cases. Need their failing input examples to reproduce fully. Sample mismatch snapshot I shared with eng:
```
REQ id=ab-req-7721
input: "Customer requests refund due to duplicate charge"
expected_label: "refund-eligible"
model_v2.2 -> "refund-eligible" (conf 0.92)
model_v2.3 -> "deny" (conf 0.81)
trace: route->model-v2.3->postprocess->label-normalize
```
This explains why their downstream ML jobs aborted; many heuristics rely on the previous label distribution.
kyle_cs: Customer quote from AB-1102: "After the model swap our pipeline started returning incorrect labels for priority cases. New Data lead is reviewing alternatives this week." They explicitly asked for a mitigation plan by EOD Thursday.
adira_csm: Risk: stakeholder change + competitor PoC = high churn probability. Procurement asked whether we can pause the rollout and revert to v2.2, or provide a dedicated short trial on v2.2 for their critical workloads while we debug. Sales wants guidance.
ryan_solutions: We can offer a short rollback window to v2.2 for their production routes and a 10-day dedicated capacity for their critical jobs while we run the diff. Require a signed mitigation acknowledgement to limit scope. No long-term discounts.
leela_eng: Technical options:
- immediate: rollback route to model-v2.2 (safe, reversible) — ETA ~1h for routing change once they approve.
- parallel: serve v2.2 for priority tenant IDs and v2.3 for new traffic while we patch v2.3 — ETA 6-12h to configure routing and warm caches.
We need: 1) sample failing inputs, 2) their acceptance to rollback or traffic-split, 3) permission to run eval harness on their masked data.
kyle_cs: Action plan: 1) Adira to secure go/no-go from Monica (Head of Data) on rollback vs split. 2) Ryan to draft the mitigation ack & limited bridge offer (10-day dedicated on v2.2). 3) Leela to prepare rollback playbook and quick diff report template. 4) Kyle to schedule exec touch (20m) to calm procurement.
ops-bot: Ticket AB-1102 updated by kyle_cs at 2025-04-11T11:02:00Z
adira_csm: I'll reach out to Monica now and propose two options (rollback to v2.2 within 1h OR traffic-split + 10-day dedicated capacity). I'll ask for 5-10 failing examples and confirm the procurement deadline.
ryan_solutions: Dropping draft mitigation ack (short): "Redwood will revert routing for listed endpoints to model-v2.2 for a timeboxed period of up to 10 days while engineering performs targeted regression analysis. Redwood will provide a post-mortem and a plan to reintroduce updated model v2.3. Customer acknowledges timeboxed support and agrees to scope limits." Thoughts?
leela_eng: Fine by eng. Add a clause: customer will provide a representative failing set (masked) or approve us to replay anonymized traffic for repro. We also want permission to enable verbose eval logs for the timebox.
kyle_cs: Good. Keep comms tight. If Monica accepts rollback we'll make routing change and post a note here. If no response in 3h, escalate to GTM lead. :thumbsup:
